history.dynasty: Modern (Isha Foundation); the Velliangiri Andavar hill shrine is far older
history.period: Adiyogi bust unveiled 24 February 2017; Velliangiri Andavar hill temple of undocumented antiquity
history.summary: This row conflates two distinct but adjacent sites at the Velliangiri foothills, documented together here. The Adiyogi bust is a 112.4-foot, ~500-tonne steel bust of Shiva at the Isha Yoga Center, unveiled by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Mahashivaratri, 24 February 2017. Conceived by Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev to honour Shiva as Adiyogi, the first yogi, the 112-foot height symbolises the 112 paths to liberation in yogic lore; Guinness World Records declared it the largest bust sculpture in the world and it is listed as an Incredible India destination. In front of the bust stands the consecrated Yogeshwar Linga. Separately, the Velliangiri Andavar Temple is an ancient Shiva shrine atop the seventh Velliangiri hill (~6,000 ft) inside a 6-foot-wide natural cave, where the swayambhu deity appears as panchalingam (five lingas) guarded by dwaarapalas; tradition says Shiva performed the tandava here at Uma's request. The Velliangiri range is revered as 'Dakshin Kailash' (Kailash of the South), and the seven-hill trek from Poondi (officially open February to May) is popularly read as a journey through the seven chakras.

name: Velliangiri Hills Temple (Adiyogi Shiva Bust)
town: Velliangiri foothills, near Semmedu/Poondi (CSV town 'Coimbatore' is approximate - the site is ~40 km west of the city)
town_description: The Velliangiri foothills area (Semmedu/Poondi, Coimbatore South sub-district) lies in the Western Ghats ~40 km west of Coimbatore city along the Siruvani route. Home to the Isha Yoga Center and the start of the Velliangiri seven-hill trek, it is a major pilgrim and trekking hub with the forested hills rising directly behind the temple complex.
tradition: Hinduism (Shaivism); the Isha Yoga Center is a spiritual centre, not a conventional temple

travel.road: Siruvani route to Poondi; regular buses from Coimbatore Central and Gandhipuram bus stands to Poondi, taxis ~1 hour

visitor_information.best_time: December to May for the hills and treks; evenings for the Adiyogi Divya Darshan light show
visitor_information.opening_hours: Adiyogi site accessible through the day (confirm on site); the Velliangiri Andavar summit trek is officially open February to May (verify)
